review_evidence: Unit-wide inventory covers 669 primary HOL Light/Candle source files across mathematical libraries, examples, theorem-prover core, Formal_ineqs, proof-recording variants, parser/runtime support and developer tooling.
Inspected `Proofrecording/diffs/*`: these are modified HOL kernel/theory/tactic sources and include object-level definitions and theorems, so they remain searchable.

Inspected all selected tooling classes: TacticTrace is tactic/conversion instrumentation plus tiny instrumentation examples; ProofTrace serializes proof traces; update_database adapts OCaml theorem-database search across compiler versions; mcp serializes goal/search/tactic state; pa_j is versioned Camlp4/Camlp5 lexer/parser infrastructure.

rules.content_invariant: Its six files wrap tactics/conversions, marshal trace records, parse OCaml compiler AST/types, or prove only tiny `1=1`/numeral examples whose sole purpose is testing the tracer; excluding them cannot hide a unique mathematical definition or theorem.
evidence: Complete six-file TacticTrace subtree inspected, including exportTrace.ml, tracer.ml, ocamlTypes.ml, types_test.ml and both examples.
rules.rationale: This subtree implements tactic/conversion tracing and its instrumentation self-tests, not a mathematical formalization surface.

rules.content_invariant: The sole file marshals existing HOL terms/proofs/theorems into strings and dumps trace datasets; it introduces no object-level mathematical theory.
rules.rationale: This subtree is ProofTrace dataset-export plumbing, not formal mathematical source.

rules.content_invariant: All five files manipulate the OCaml toplevel environment and the existing `theorems` registry; none defines a new HOL object-level mathematical statement.
evidence: All five update_database files inspected; each is an OCaml-version compatibility implementation of the same theorem-database update/search utility.
rules.rationale: These files are version-specific OCaml adapters for rebuilding/searching HOL Light’s theorem-name database.

rules.content_invariant: The sole file serializes goals/theorems to JSON and invokes existing search/tactic operations; it owns no mathematical formalization.
rules.rationale: This subtree is MCP JSON/API glue around the interactive HOL goal/search/tactic state.

rules.content_invariant: The 15-file subtree is parser/lexer infrastructure copied/adapted across OCaml/Camlp versions. It changes host-language syntax handling, not HOL mathematical definitions/statements/proofs.
evidence: Inspected old and current endpoints pa_j_3.07.ml and pa_j_5.4_8.04.00.ml and inventoried all 15 version-specific parser files.
rules.rationale: These versioned files implement the Camlp4/Camlp5 lexer/parser syntax extension required to parse HOL Light source.

summary: Reviewed Candle/HOL Light conservatively; mathematical theories, prover core and proof-recording theory variants remain searchable, while only explicit trace/search/MCP/parser implementation tooling is excluded.
